clauses.quote: Teachers who submit the DINR form by April 1 annually, but who decide to remain in the school system the following year, shall incur no loss of pay or benefits
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who submit the DINR form by April 1 annually, but who decide to remain in the school system the following year
clauses.notes: Conditioned on notifying DCPS by April 30 and withdrawing DINR form.

clauses.quote: If such Teachers do not notify DCPS by April 30 annually, they shall incur a $1,000 penalty in the form of withheld compensation.
clauses.notes: Conditioned on failure to notify by April 30.

clauses.quote: This penalty shall not apply to Teachers who declare an intent to retire, but who subsequently find that they are ineligible to do so.
clauses.notes: Exempts retiring teachers from the penalty.

clauses.quote: Teachers who do not submit a DINR form by April 1 annually, but who decide to leave the school system the following year shall incur a $1,000 penalty in the form of withheld compensation.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who do not submit a DINR form by April 1 annually, but who decide to leave the school system the following year
clauses.notes: Penalty for failing to submit DINR when leaving.

clauses.quote: This penalty shall not apply to Teachers who are terminated by DCPS.
clauses.notes: Exempts terminated teachers from the penalty.

clauses.quote: Teachers who incur the penalties outlined above shall have the right to request a waiver from the Chancellor.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who incur the penalties outlined above

clauses.quote: The Chancellor shall have the sole authority to grant such waivers at her/his discretion.
The dental, optical, and legal service plans shall be contracted by the WTU, subject to a competitive bidding process.
clauses.subject_text: The dental, optical, and legal service plans
clauses.notes: Imposes a competitive bidding requirement on the union.

clauses.quote: The WTU shall be responsible for the administration of the dental, optical, and legal service plans
and shall bear all related administrative costs.
DCPS shall be held harmless from any liability arising from the administration of the optical, dental and legal service plans.
clauses.notes: Holds district harmless from union-administered plan liabilities.

clauses.quote: The WTU shall provide DCPS with quarterly reports on all benefit programs.
